messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main()
{
	int n;
	cin >> n;
	int* arr = new int[n];
	for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)
		cin >> arr[i];
	int t;
	cin >> t;
	sort(arr, arr + n);
	int count;
	int max = 0, j;
	for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)
	{
		count = 0;
		j = i;
		int k = t;
		while(k >= 0 && j < n)
		{
			count++;
			if(j < n - 1)
				k -= (arr[j + 1] - arr[j]);
			j++;
		}
		if(max < count)
			max = count;
	}
	delete[] arr;
	cout << max << endl;
	return 0;
}
